description: An independent performance auditor for a trading strategy or backtest. From a trade list and/or periodic returns it computes win rate, expectancy, profit factor, streaks, Sharpe/Sortino/drawdown, and tests whether the edge is real: t-stat, Probabilistic Sharpe Ratio and the Deflated Sharpe Ratio that corrects for how many variants you tried. Returns a verdict and red flags. Price: $0.1.

n_trials.description: How many strategy/parameter variants were tested before picking this one. Default 1.

starting_equity.description: For risk-of-ruin and drawdown in dollars from trades.

trial_sharpe_variance.description: Variance of per-period Sharpe across trials, if known.

name: strategy_audit
title: Strategy audit and overfitting check
